# Copilot instructions

- Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first. It is the source of truth for this project's purpose, commands, boundaries and definition of done. If this file and AGENTS.md disagree, AGENTS.md wins.
- Follow [docs/constitution.md](../docs/constitution.md) and the scoped rules in `.github/instructions/`.
- Run only the commands listed in AGENTS.md. Ask before running anything else.
- Never write code for an issue until its plan in `docs/work/<issue-id>/plan.md` has `Status: Approved`.
- Never ask for, print, or store secret values. Never put real customer or regulated data in prompts, logs, tests or fixtures.
- If something is unknown, say so and ask. Do not invent requirements, commands or facts.
